terra.problem: The claim that seven appears often in the Bible is outside this passage and has no reference.
It gives preventing a later mix-up as the reason for writing the names, but the text does not state that reason.
Saying Aaron's staff makes the twelfth implies it was added last. The passage says only that it was among the twelve.
Aaron being Moses' brother and a priest is information from outside this passage and needs a reference.
It states that Korah was fresh in everybody's mind without marking that as a guess.
The description of Korah as a Levite who led the rebellion comes from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Aaron being Moses' brother and a priest is information from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say the staff was dry.
The passage reports what happened to Aaron's staff but does not say the other eleven remained plain sticks.
The passage does not say what happened to Judah's staff.
The passage does not say that Reuben's staff did not change.
Moses sees the buds, blossoms and almonds the next day. The text does not give the sequence in which they appeared or say they appeared overnight.
The text does not say the staff is on display so everyone knows it is there.
The text says the sign is for the rebellious, but does not say that excludes priests.
It states that the Israelites are worried without marking that feeling as Papa Dorin's guess.
